offers_products.reason: Manufactures pistols, revolvers, rifles (M&P, Performance Center), and accessories, plus branded gear.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from firearms and accessories manufacturing; no significant service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Firearms for sport shooters, hunters and self-defense buyers; branded apparel and gear sold directly to shoppers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells through distributors and retailers for resale, plus law enforcement/government handcuffs and M&P firearms.

recurring_revenue.reason: Firearms are occasional purchases; revenue depends on unit sales through distributors rather than subscriptions or contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Consumer firearm purchases are discretionary and swing with sentiment and spending; they can be postponed.

big_ticket.reason: A handgun or rifle is a few hundred dollars; moderate and infrequent but not large like homes or machinery.

people_delivered.reason: A manufacturer of firearms; customers pay for goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual shooters and distributors/retailers; government and law enforcement are a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates firearm manufacturing plants with machining equipment that need ongoing capital investment.

notes: Asset-heavy and big-ticket are judgment calls. Website text shows mostly branded gear, but the company is mainly a firearms maker.
